profile.emailNote: Notifications only. Not verified or used to sign in.
profile.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, or leave it empty.
password.changed: Password changed. You’re signed out everywhere else.
password.changeNote: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
password.setNote: Lets you sign in with @{username} and a password.

provider.notLinked: Sign in here with your {provider} account.

revoke.heading: Security
revoke.intro: If something looks wrong, start again with a new password.

passkeys.signInAt: Sign in at {host} with your face, fingerprint or screen lock.
passkeys.confirmSynced: Remove {name}? It is signed out on every device that shares it.

general.heading: General
general.name: Workspace name
general.guestsNote: Guests only see items shared with them.
general.exportNote: Documents, databases, files and comments, in one .stuga.zip.
general.exportBackups: For a full backup with version history, use <link>Backups</link>.
general.dangerNote: Permanently deletes all content, members and agent keys.
members.added: {name} is now {role, select, owner {an owner} admin {an admin} guest {a guest} other {a member}}.
members.linkRevoked: Link turned off. Nobody can join with it any more.
groups.heading: Groups
groups.note: Share with a group to reach everyone in it.
groups.exists: There is already a group called “{name}”.
groups.empty: No one in this group yet.
groups.addFailed: Couldn’t add them to the group.
groups.removeFailed: Couldn’t remove them from the group.
members.heading: Members
members.noMatch: No one outside this workspace matches. Send them an invite link instead.
members.rolesNote: Owners manage everything, admins included; admins add and remove people. Members open what’s shared with the workspace, guests only what’s shared with them.
members.onlyOwnerHint: To leave, make someone else an owner first.
members.makeOwnerDescription: Owners can do everything you can: change anyone’s role, yours included, and delete the workspace.
members.stepDownDescription: You’ll be {role, select, admin {an admin} guest {a guest} other {a member}}. Only another owner can make you an owner again.
members.invitesNote: Anyone with a link can create an account on this server and join this workspace.
members.invitesFailed: Couldn’t load this workspace’s invite links.
members.revokeTitleFor: Turn off the invite link for {note}?
members.revokeDescription: Nobody can join with it after this. People who already joined stay.
members.leaveDescription: You lose access to every document shared through this workspace, and any agent keys you created here stop working. An owner or admin has to invite you back.
members.removeDescription: They lose access to every document shared through this workspace, and any agent keys they created here stop working. Documents they created stay in this workspace. You can invite them again later.
invite.memberNote: Sees what is shared with the workspace.
invite.guestNote: Sees only what is shared with them.
invite.adminNote: A member who also manages people and links.
invite.summary: Admits {who, select, one {one person} unlimited {anyone with the link} other {up to {count, plural, other {# people}}}} as {role, select, admin {an admin} guest {a guest} other {a member}}. {expiry, select, never {Works until revoked.} other {Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.}}
invite.notShownAgain: This link isn’t shown again once you close this.
invite.forHint: Shown in the list of links, so you can tell them apart.
invite.adminOnce: An admin link can be used once.
agents.instructions.heading: Instructions for agents
agents.intro: Rules for every agent in this workspace, yours and everyone else’s. To connect your own, go to <link>Your AI agents</link>.
agents.instructions.intro: Shared defaults for every agent. Add item-specific instructions from its ⋯ menu.
agents.instructions.label: Instructions
agents.instructions.placeholder:
Example:
- Daily notes go in Journal/, one document per day, appended to.
- Never edit anything under Contracts/.
- Tasks live in the Tasks database; add rows, don’t rewrite them.
agents.instructions.saved: Instructions saved. Agents use them from their next turn.
agents.changes.heading: Agent changes
agents.changes.wait: Agent edits wait until someone accepts or rejects them.
agents.changes.direct: To let them apply directly on one item, choose {menuItem} from its ⋯ menu. Check the agent’s record in {page} first.
agents.webhooks.heading: Webhooks
agents.webhooks.about: Send workspace events to another app.
agents.webhooks.signature: Each request is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the {header} header, using the secret shown when you add the webhook.
agents.webhooks.shownOnce: Shown once. The receiving app uses it to check that each request came from Stuga.
usage.tokensNote: A token is about three quarters of a word. AI services charge by the token.
usage.forbidden: You can’t see this workspace’s AI usage

usage.none: No AI has run in this workspace in {month}.

audit.retention: Retention is set in Node settings → Storage.
audit.contentNote: Who did what to the workspace, its sharing and its people. Edits to the text itself are in each document’s version history.
